/* Since Effdate and Term Date were added during Acceptance Test, there are some rows for which
 Eff_Date is null. In order to allow user to enter Eff_Date for existing physician records, 
 NVL function is used with Eff_Date also otherwise eff_date item becomes non-updateable if 
 Eff_date is null. 
*/

declare
 cursor speciality_cur is select description 
 from valid_master_codes 
 where code_type='PHYSP' 
 and code = :physician_list.specialty_code ;
 
 cursor city_state_zip_cur is select city, state, zip 
 from valid_city_state
 where usps_id = :physician_list.usps_id;
 
 
begin 
 open speciality_cur ;
 fetch speciality_cur into :physician_list.specialty_desc ;
 close speciality_cur ;

 open city_state_zip_cur ;
 fetch city_state_zip_cur into :physician_list.city,
 :physician_list.state,
 :physician_list.zip_code ;
 close city_state_zip_cur ;
end ;



if nvl(:physician_list.eff_date,sysdate) < sysdate then
 if get_item_property('physician_list.eff_date', updateable) ='TRUE' then
 set_item_property('physician_list.eff_date', updateable, property_false);
 end if ;
else
 if get_item_property('physician_list.eff_date', updateable) ='FALSE' then
 set_item_property('physician_list.eff_date', updateable, property_true);
 end if ;
end if ;

end if;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_PHONE_NO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_phone_no (p_phone_no in varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if p_phone_no is not null then
 if ltrim(p_phone_no,'1234567890') is not null then
 show_error('9208') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 if to_number(p_phone_no) <= 0 or NVL(length(p_phone_no), 0) != 7 then
 show_error('16054');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 end if;
 end if ;
exception 
 when value_error then
 show_error('16054');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_AREA_CODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_area_code (p_area_code in varchar2) IS
 selection varchar2(1) ;
begin
 if p_area_code is not null then
 if ltrim(p_area_code,'1234567890') is not null then
 show_error('9208') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 begin
 select 'x' into selection
 from valid_master_codes 
 where code_type = 'AREAC' 
 and code = p_area_code;
 exception
 when no_data_found then show_error('9207') ; check_package_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if;

END;

PROCEDURE enable_disable_address (pl_mode in varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if pl_mode = 'D' then
 
 item_change('physician_list.STREET_NAME','D'); 
 --item_change('physician_list.CITY','D'); 
 --item_change('physician_list.ZIP_CODE','D'); 
 --item_change('physician_list.STATE','D'); 
 --item_change('physician_list.AREA_CODE','D'); 
 --item_change('physician_list.PHONE_NO','D'); 
 elsif pl_mode = 'E' then
 
 item_change('physician_list.STREET_NAME','E'); 
 --item_change('physician_list.CITY','E'); 
 -- item_change('physician_list.ZIP_CODE','E'); 
 --item_change('physician_list.STATE','E'); 
 --item_change('physician_list.AREA_CODE','E'); 
 --item_change('physician_list.PHONE_NO','E'); 
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOCAL_ADDR_POPULATED

Function local_addr_populated return BOOLEAN IS
BEGIN
 If :physician_list.street_name is not null OR :physician_list.city is not null OR :physician_list.area_code is not null then
 return TRUE;
 else
 return false;
 end if;
END;

 If :physician_list.street_name is null 
 and :physician_list.city is null
 and :physician_list.zip_code is null
 and :physician_list.area_code is null
 and :physician_list.phone_no is null
 
 return true;
 else
 return false;
 end if;
 */
